params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 50, maximum of 100.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: Token for pagination

params.name: createdAt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Supports the > and < operators. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those created in the specified range. e.g. > 2017-04-30. Date ranges can be specified with the following nomenclature > YYYY-MM-DD AND <YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: modifiedAt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Supports the > and < operators. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified in the specified range. e.g. > 2017-04-30. Date ranges can be specified with the following nomenclature > YYYY-MM-DD AND <YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of a Molecule. Restricts results to those with the specified name, alias, or entity registry ID.

params.name: nameIncludes
params.description: Name substring of a Molecule. Restricts results to those with names, aliases, or entity registry IDs that include the provided substring.

params.name: folderId
params.description: ID of a folder. Restricts results to those in the folder.

params.name: mentionedIn
params.description: Comma-separated list of entry IDs. Restricts results to Molecules mentioned in those entries.

params.name: projectId
params.description: ID of a project. Restricts results to those in the project.

params.name: registryId
params.description: ID of a registry. Restricts results to those registered in this registry. Specifying "null" returns unregistered items.

params.name: schemaId
params.description: ID of a schema. Restricts results to those of the specified schema.

params.name: schemaFields
params.description: Filter based on schema field value (not display value). Restricts results to those with a field whose value matches the filter. For Integer, Float, and Date type fields, supports the >= and <= operators (but not < or >). If any schemaField filters are present, the schemaId param must also be present. Note that all operators must be separated from any values by a single space.

params.name: archiveReason
params.description: Archive reason. Restricts results to those with the specified archive reason. Use "NOT_ARCHIVED" to filter for unarchived Molecules. Use "ANY_ARCHIVED" to filter for archived Molecules regardless of reason. Use "ANY_ARCHIVED_OR_NOT_ARCHIVED" to return items for both archived and unarchived.

params.name: mentions
params.description: Comma-separated list of item IDs. Restricts results to those that mention the given items in the description.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of ids. Matches all of the provided IDs, or returns a 400 error that includes a list of which IDs are invalid.

params.name: entityRegistryIds.anyOf
params.description: Comma-separated list of entity registry IDs. Maximum of 100. Restricts results to those that match any of the specified registry IDs.

params.name: names.anyOf
params.description: Comma-separated list of names. Maximum of 100. Restricts results to those that match any of the specified names, aliases, or entity registry IDs.

params.name: authorIds.anyOf
params.description: Comma separated list of user or app IDs. Maximum of 100.

params.name: chemicalSubstructure.mol
params.description: mol-formatted string for a chemical substructure to search by

params.name: chemicalSubstructure.smiles
params.description: SMILES string for a chemical substructure to search by

info.name: Create or update a registered Molecule

items.docs:
Create or update a registered Molecule.

Schema field links can be populated using entity registry IDs or API IDs. In the `value` field of the [Field](#/components/schemas/FieldWithResolution) resource, the object `{"entityRegistryId": ENTITY_REGISTRY_ID}` may be provided instead of the API ID if desired (see example value).

params.name: returning
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Modifies the output shape. To return all keys at a given level, enumerate them or use the wildcard, '*'. For more information, [click here](https://docs.benchling.com/docs/getting-started-1#returning-query-parameter).

items.docs:
All entities and their schemas must be within the same registry.

This operation performs the following actions:
1. Any existing objects are looked up in Benchling by the provided entity registry ID.
